name: robots.txt Generator
summary: Build a robots.txt with Allow/Disallow paths and an optional Sitemap line — locally.
description: Set a User-agent, list Allow and Disallow paths, add a Sitemap URL, and optionally Crawl-delay. Copy the robots.txt for static hosting. Nothing is crawled or uploaded.

faqs.question: Does robots.txt hide private pages?
faqs.answer: No. It asks well-behaved crawlers not to fetch paths. It is not access control.

faqs.question: Is Crawl-delay standard?
faqs.answer: It is supported by some crawlers but not part of the original robots exclusion standard. Use sparingly.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. The file is generated in your browser.
